name: criteq
description: CritEQ: High-precision Neubrutalist Equalizer for macOS with Audio EQ Cookbook DSP, PEQ APO support, and low-latency CoreAudio engine

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:native && npm run build:renderer
scripts.icon: mkdir -p build && swift scripts/generate-icon.swift && iconutil -c icns build/AppIcon.iconset -o build/icon.icns
scripts.package: rm -rf release CritEQ.app && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-packager . CritEQ --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --asar --ignore="^/(release|CritEQ\.app|src|tests|coverage|Preset|build|scripts|tasks|anti-slop|Windows porting|\.git|tsconfig\.json|vite\.config\.ts|vitest\.config\.ts|design\.md)" --icon=build/icon --app-bundle-id=com.criteq.app --app-category-type=public.app-category.music --extra-resource=dist/main/native-audio-engine && codesign --force --deep --sign - release/CritEQ-darwin-arm64/CritEQ.app && mv release/CritEQ-darwin-arm64/CritEQ.app ./CritEQ.app && rm -rf release

author: CritEQ Contributors
